title: #050. Conflict Diagnosis & Minimum-Cost Repair Synthesis
subtitle: Chapter 5 synthesis: detect policy consistency, extract a minimal unsat core when inconsistent, and compute minimum-weight soft-rule repairs.
caseNames: Mixed boolean and integer equality conflict

judge.m0: Output must be an object { consistent, minimalCore, relaxedRules, repairCost, repairedAssignment }.
judge.m1: Returned consistent = {p0}, but combined hard+soft rules are actually {p1}.
judge.m2: When consistent is true, minimalCore and relaxedRules must be empty and repairCost must be 0.
judge.m3: Hard rule "{p0}" is violated by repairedAssignment.
judge.m6: When inconsistent, minimalCore cannot be empty.
judge.m8: Returned minimalCore [{p0}] is NOT minimal: removing "{p1}" leaves it unsatisfiable.
judge.m9: relaxedRules [{p0}] does not match soft rules actually violated by repairedAssignment ([{p1}]).
judge.m10: Reported repairCost ({p0}) does not match actual relaxed rule weights ({p1}).
judge.m11: Valid repair, but repairCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
judge.m13: Diagnosed minimal core and synthesized optimal repair (repairCost = {p0})!
